card.name: Slot before a comparison word like similar
card.fires_on: Small linking words (of, was, is, to, approximately) right where a comparison word such as similar, higher, lower or equal is expected next. Seen after a measured quantity or rate in results text, and after a noun in descriptions of likeness.

modes.label: Verb after a rate or outcome
modes.description: was or is following a rate, incidence or proportion, just before a comparison like similar, higher or lower.
modes.example: The incidence of infections (60% vs 58%) and serious infections (2% vs 2%)<< was>> similar in patients treated with dimethyl f

modes.label: Of before same or uniform
modes.description: The word of after a noun or adjective, leading into same, equal or uniform.
modes.example: This battle was one of the few occasions where a German raider met an opponent <<of>> the same type.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward saying similar and away from minimum or minimal.
card.plain: It marks the spot where the text is about to say something is similar to, or compared with, something else.
